subject: Canonical acceptance for Dawn Incremental Enrichment 1.0
body: Starting from the consumed 32-source working set, run delta-only Dawn enrichment. Return at least 8 genuinely new qualified sources with provenance, rights and at least 6 source families; prove a repeated third pass returns zero; update the durable Storybook workflow and parent goal to PASS only at >=40 references and >=6 families. Return one terminal canonical receipt.
